The confidence dial 'reaches every kind-level claim, whatever its head' and sets a contingent claim whose arguments are both bare kinds at 0.9, never the individual-fact 0.99 ('when unsure → empirical'), so (STV 1.0 0.99) on this atom is wrong however the atom is attached.

gaps_confirmed: an adjunct (purpose / manner / time PP) on a relational generic: the kind relation is a fixed two-slot opaque atom with no room for it, and only the adjectivally-restricted SUBJECT case is legislated (that one forces the distributing-rule route instead)

an object-incorporating gerund nominalization ('time-keeping') fits none of the three compound rules — it is not verb_object, not modifier_noun with a head noun, and not an agent nominalization — so the symbol is left whole with no stated licence
new_gaps: what a licensed form would have to carry for the confirmed defect: a purpose 'for'-PP on a bare relational generic needs either a third slot on the opaque kind relation, or an explicit licence to take the distributing-rule route (as an adjectivally-restricted subject does) so the adjunct can ride the reified event as the already-licensed (For (sk_carry $x) time_keeping); neither exists, so the sentence's full content has no licensed encoding
